description: This PHP class defines a CLI command for toggling the system check screen in the OrangeHRM system. It includes configuration of command options and execution logic to enable or disable the feature.

classes.name: ToggleSystemCheckScreenCommand
classes.description: Defines a console command to toggle the system check screen setting in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the name of the CLI command.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the command description and options.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command logic to toggle the system check screen based on the provided options.
